SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Mag. c.]
Feeling of emptiness and qualmishness in stomach ; > after dinner.
Great amount of wind, which is sour when eructated.
Aching and contractive pain, with sour eructations.
Constrictive pain in stomach.
Ulcerative pain in stomach, with great sensitiveness to pressure.
Meteorism of stomach when it is sensitive to touch ; no eructation.
Sour eructations and pyrosis after cabbage, potatoes, and other gross food.
Milk is refused, or if taken, causes pain in stomach.
From indigestion, disposition to furuncles and headache ; tongue coated dirty yellow.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Mag. c.]
Hardness with stitches in hepatic region.
Insupportable pain in left hypochondriac region through to back ; must support spot with hand and get up and walk about ; < lying down and at night ; sleepless for one week ; toothache in right upper and lower jaw < from cold water.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Mag. c.]
Pain over umbilicus, when feeling that part.
Cutting about navel, > from emitting flatus.
Cutting and pinching in abdomen ; griping before stool.
Pressing, spasmodic, contracting, colicky pains ; > by green stools.
Colic, followed by leucorrhœa.
Great heaviness in bloated abdomen.
Pressing towards pelvis, as if menses would come on, with cutting in abdomen.
Abdomen excessively distended ; profuse emission of flatus, with relief.
Violent audible rumbling, gurgling, and moving back and forth, with fine cutting in abdomen all day.
Affection of left abdominal ring ; inguinal hernia.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Mag. c.]
Stools : green, like scum on a frog pond ; sour, frothy ; with white, floating lumps, like tallow ; bloody, mucous ; green, mucous ; greenish yellow ; brown, fluid ; green and frothy ; of a liver colored fluid ; followed by tenesmus and burning ; of greenish water, with great distension of abdomen.
The bloody mucus is found mixed with green, watery stool, sinking to bottom of vessel and adhering there ; but the watery stool occurs alone. θ Dysentery. θ Infantile diarrhœa.
Lienteria of sucklings ; milk passes undigested.
Diarrhœa, with violent cutting colic and pressure, as many as seven or eight times a day, for eight days.
Griping and rumbling in whole abdomen, followed by diarrhœa, thin and green, without tenesmus.
Diarrhœa ; preceded by cutting colic ; much wind in bowels.
Green, watery diarrhœa regularly every three weeks.
Watery, yellowish brown diarrhœa, containing white particles, looking as if chopped up ; vomiting of mucus ; extreme and rapid emaciation.
Stools offensive and watery, containing floating masses of green scum ; some straining, and during stool child did not wish to be touched. θ Infantile diarrhœa.
Sour eructations ; whole child smells sour ; great thirst, especially evenings. θ Cholera infantum.
Diarrhœa of young children ; milk causes pain in stomach, is rejected, or passes bowels undigested ; stools green, sour smelling ; colicky pains.
Constant, sour, rather whitish, watery diarrhœa. θ Infantile remittent fever.
Stool only every second day.
Costive ; frequent, ineffectual urging, with small stools, or only flatus ; stitches in anus ; stool hard as a stone ; frequent effort to pass a natural looking stool ; stitches in anus and rectum.
Before stool : colic ; cutting and pinching in abdomen ; general heat ; rumbling ; emission of flatus.
During stool : colic ; urging ; tenesmus.
After stool : tenesmus ; burning at anus.
Woke about 4 A. M. with intolerable pain in rectum, as if pierced with needles.
Ascarides and lumbrici.
Always < after walking some distance, sufferings being proportionate to extent of walk ; prickings in rectum after walking. θ Ascarides.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Mag. c.]
Urine : increased, pale, watery or green ; with white sediment.
Involuntary urination while walking or rising from a seat.
Burning, smarting during urination.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Mag. c.]
Sexual desire diminished ; erections wanting.
Prostatic fluid so easily discharged that even emission of flatus causes it.
Inguinal and scrotal hernia.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Mag. c.]
Menses : late, scanty ; stop in afternoon ; flow acrid, dark, pitch-like ; profuse and too early, flowing more at night and at first on rising, also between uterine pains ; blood thick, dark, glutinous, like pitch, difficult to wash off.
Before menses : coryza and obstructed nostrils, sore throat, labor-like pains, cutting colic, backache, weakness, chilliness.
At commencement of menses, heavy headache, coryza, pale face, drawing pain in sides and great lassitude.
During menses : violent pains in abdomen ; weakness, chilliness, headache, paleness of face, pain in small of back, or spasmodic, pressing pain in abdomen.
Menses flow more profusely during night, with dragging pains ; > on pressing on abdomen and on stooping.
Menses lessen or cease to flow in afternoon.
Flow dark, very profuse, but much more profuse during night and at first rising than during day ; on rising in morning, contractive pain in abdomen, and sharp upward stitches in rectum, followed by discharge of coagula from vagina.
Milk always causes distress in stomach and sour risings ; subject to frequent diarrhœa. θ Metrorrhagia.
Leucorrhœa : acrid, white, mucous, preceded by colic ; watery after menses ; thin, scanty, with pinching around navel ; smarting in afternoon, when walking or sitting.
Frequent itching of pudendum.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Mag. c.]
Toothache during pregnancy, more during night.
During pregnancy : constant nausea, no vomiting ; sour taste and sour vomiting ; appetite for certain kinds of food ; earthy color of face ; tendency to cry ; stitches in l. side under short ribs ; all symptoms < every third week ; much roughness, or stinging, or burning in throat, with desire to vomit ; eructations tasting of rotten eggs.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Mag. c.]
Sudden stammering ; occasional aphasia.
   

COUGH. [27] [Mag. c.]
Cough : spasmodic, at night ; from tickling in larynx ; sputum, mornings and during day, yellow, thin or tough mucus, or dark blood, tasting saltish ; < in evening until after midnight.
Fits of spasmodic cough at night in persons much troubled with ascarides.
Expectoration of soft tubercles big as a pea and very offensive in smell.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Mag. c.]
Oppression of chest, with sensation of constriction.
Soreness in chest and region of heart ; stitches.
Stitch from without inward in precordial region.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Mag. c.]
Stiffness in neck.
Pain in back and small of back at night, as if broken.
Sudden, violent, concussive, tearing, stitching pain in coccygeal region as if spine was bent back.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Mag. c.]
Much pain in head and right shoulder ; she can scarcely raise right arm.
Pain as from dislocation of shoulder joint when moving it.
Rheumatic pain in shoulders (at night), with tingling down to fingers ; pain prevents least movement.
Lameness of right arm, with pain in shoulder, without swelling of soreness.
Tubercle on wrist pouring out clear water when pressed.
Chapping of skin of hands.
Spreading, corroding, stinging vesicles on hands and fingers.
Red, inflammatory swelling of fingers.
Heat of fingers (in fever).
